text: {"verdict": "refuted", "answer": "The evidence states that PP2A activity is downregulated by ATM-mediated phosphorylation, so reduced PP2A phosphorylation would raise PP2A activity, not lower it. Consistently, in ATM deficiency (where PP2A phosphorylation is reduced) enhanced PP2A activity leads to HDAC4 dephosphorylation and nuclear accumulation. Thus reduced phosphorylation of PP2A promotes, rather than suppresses, HDAC4 dephosphorylation.", "evidence_used": ["3113630"]}
